view: Frontal (PA) chest radiograph, erect; 'L' side marker with technologist initials 'DG' projected over the patient's left shoulder (image upper right), confirming conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate inspiration with apices and both costophrenic angles included. Mildly rotated (sternotomy wires/sternum project to the patient's right of the thoracic spine, mediastinal contours accentuated). High-contrast/relatively penetrated processing: lungs render very dark while bones are bright, which limits assessment of subtle lung parenchymal detail. Scapulae partly overlap the lateral upper lung fields. Overall diagnostic.

devices.type: Median sternotomy cerclage wires (8 wires: 4 upper loop wires and 4 lower twisted wires), intact, no fracture or displacement
devices.location: Anterior midline chest / sternum, projecting slightly to the patient's right of the thoracic spine due to rotation, from the manubrium to the lower sternum

devices.type: Ring-shaped metallic marker ~0.9-1.0 cm (consistent with coronary bypass graft marker or surgical clip)
devices.location: Projected over the right hilum / medial right middle zone, adjacent to the right cardiomediastinal border, just to the patient's right of the sternotomy wires

devices.type: External radiographic side marker 'L' with initials 'DG'
devices.location: Over the patient's left shoulder / acromioclavicular region (image upper right)

abnormalities.finding: Bilateral hyperlucent lungs with attenuated, sparse peripheral vascular markings, most marked in the upper zones, suggestive of emphysema; diaphragmatic doming preserved so frank hyperinflation is not marked. No focal consolidation, mass or pneumothorax.

Prominent, bulging aortic knob / unfolded thoracic aorta with widening of the upper-left mediastinal contour (likely tortuous/ectatic aorta in an elderly patient; partly accentuated by rotation). Trachea midline.
Heart size borderline/upper limit of normal (estimated CTR ~0.48-0.50), left heart border reaching far laterally; assessment limited by rotation. Post median sternotomy / probable prior CABG.

Mild coarse reticular/interstitial markings at the medial right lung base near the cardiophrenic angle, possibly scarring or minor subsegmental atelectasis; right costophrenic angle sharp, no effusion.

Left glenohumeral joint: humeral head appears superiorly positioned relative to the glenoid with possible narrowing of the acromiohumeral interval / degenerative change; limited by positioning. Right shoulder grossly intact.
Patient rotation: sternum/sternotomy wires projected to the patient's right of the spine (technical).

description_zh: 正面（PA）站立胸部X光，可見左側「L」標記，影像稍有旋轉且對比偏強。胸骨正中可見8條完整之胸骨鋼絲，右肺門內側緊鄰右心縱膈緣處另見一約1公分之環狀金屬標記，符合冠狀動脈繞道手術後之移植血管標記或手術夾，未見胸管或引流管。雙肺透亮度增加、周邊血管紋理稀疏（以上肺野較明顯），懷疑肺氣腫；橫膈仍呈圓頂狀、無明顯過度充氣，未見肺實質浸潤、腫塊、肋膜積液或氣胸，雙側肋膈角銳利。主動脈弓突出、上縱膈左側輪廓增寬（疑為老年性主動脈迂曲，部分受旋轉影響），心影大小約在正常上限（CTR約0.48–0.50）；右肺底內側有輕微粗網狀紋理，左肩盂肱關節疑有退化性變化。
